films.name: Cadbury Dairy Milk cricket

films.message: Cadbury Dairy Milk: something special in all of us; the real taste of life.

A burst of very fast cuts of faces and the pitch at the moment of release.
The woman in the floral dress runs onto the open grass and dances while a policeman tries to catch her and officials and crowd watch, one long wide shot with pigeons.
A swirl of chocolate and milk around the bar and the written line asli swad zindagi ka (the real taste of life).

scenes.purpose: the star arrives and introduces the product as the answer
scenes.change: the star and the bottle enter the scene

scenes.purpose: the drink unleashes the energy payoff, the spectacle the film is built around
scenes.change: drinking triggers crackling electricity; the professor is rocked

scenes.purpose: the professor's stunned reaction confirms the transformation landed
scenes.change: the professor is won over, mood turns to awe

scenes.purpose: lands the brand line and product with the jingle
scenes.change: the message and brand are stated

findings.note: The film opens quietly (scene 1: energy 1, intensity 1). The first seconds must earn the next five with something unexpected, a question or a visible action.
6 neighbouring scenes (scene 1 to 6) happen in the same place ('lab'). A viewer sees one room for as long as it lasts: change the place, the time of day or the scale, or cut one.
Nothing builds until scene 4 (3 of 6 scenes in). Escalate earlier, or give the opening scenes a stake of their own.

read.summary: A tense living-room spat over a missed show tips into relief when one partner reveals it was recorded on mobile, resolving into warmth and the brand line.

scenes.purpose: opens on a frozen stand-off — his sheepish smile against her shock poses the question of what he's done
scenes.change: a confrontation is set up; we want to know his confession

scenes.purpose: holds the tension in the silence between them, letting the awkwardness sit
scenes.change: the pause deepens the standoff without resolving it

scenes.purpose: he confesses the show was missed, then stumbles toward the idea of recording — the pivot in the quarrel
scenes.change: the real problem is named and the solution is hinted at

scenes.purpose: the recording reveal lands, her anger melts into a smile and the quarrel dissolves into affection
scenes.change: conflict turns to warmth — the fight is won by the recording

scenes.purpose: names the mechanism plainly: you can record on Tata Sky from your mobile
scenes.change: the viewer now knows the product capability behind the gag

scenes.purpose: brand and tagline land with the app icon and call to download
scenes.change: the product and its promise are fixed as the takeaway

findings.note: The film opens quietly (scene 1: energy 1, intensity 1). The first seconds must earn the next five with something unexpected, a question or a visible action.
4 neighbouring scenes (scene 1 to 4) happen in the same place ('living room'). A viewer sees one room for as long as it lasts: change the place, the time of day or the scale, or cut one.
Scenes 1 to 3 are all held stills or small gestures: nothing happens on screen for 3 scenes in a row. Give at least one of them an action, a reveal or a moving camera.
Scenes 1, 2 are ONE beat shown at more than one scale; the first holds the beat and the others are its closer view (no extra angles on them).

read.summary: A flirtatious cafe chase in one take where a man clocks a woman on the phone and ends up beside her, both talking, landing a local-call discount — fun to watch but it coasts on a single idea.

scenes.purpose: a stranger's glance opens a question — who is she, will he follow
scenes.change: he notices her and turns, the flirtation begins

scenes.purpose: his interest becomes a playful pursuit as she keeps moving
scenes.change: he signals to her; the chase is now mutual

scenes.purpose: the charged in-between where he watches and waits
scenes.change: tension holds but little advances — the weakest beat

scenes.purpose: they land together, both on the phone — the flirtation pays off
scenes.change: they are side by side; the meet-up is resolved

scenes.purpose: the offer lands: the local-call discount that connects them
scenes.change: the flirtation reframes as a telecom offer, fade to black

findings.note: 5 neighbouring scenes (scene 1 to 5) happen in the same place ('cafe'). A viewer sees one room for as long as it lasts: change the place, the time of day or the scale, or cut one.
Nothing builds until scene 4 (3 of 5 scenes in). Escalate earlier, or give the opening scenes a stake of their own.
